features.title: Strangers Stay Out
features.detail:
Your main address works like "don't email me, I'll email you". Only your contacts get in. Post it on a website or a business card, and strangers are still turned away before they reach your inbox. Most spam and scam emails never arrive.

Each purpose address keeps its own list of allowed senders. If one ever leaks, switch it off or delete it, and every other address keeps working as before.

features.title: Know Who Is Writing, and Why
features.detail: No random strings to forget. Name each address after its purpose, like a_happy.rhino_shopping@, and every email tells you who sent it and why. Use Permission Enforced for shopping and newsletters, and Cold Reach Allowed for a business card.

features.title: Be Believed
features.detail: a_harry.potter@ is an anonymous Harry Potter. harry.potter@ is a verified one. With an identity inbox, your address itself shows people it's really you, in every inbox, with no login needed.

features.title: Control From Every Email
features.detail: Every forwarded email comes with a short summary: the real sender, plus warnings for tracking pixels, insecure links, or a "business" writing from free Gmail. Allow or stop a sender in one click. Forged senders never reach you.

features.title: Your Mail, Your Key. Leave Any Time.
features.detail:
Emails we keep for you are encrypted with secret words only you know. There is no master key, not even ours, and they are deleted after 30 days. Download your full configuration or delete your account whenever you like.
How we encrypt your mail · Our exit policy
